purpose: Retrospective metric-origin and null audit; not model selection or leaderboard estimates
evaluation_caveats: Held public panels contain 11/18/18 targets, not the official 300-target contexts or anchors.
Common source controls pool different technical batches; this is not a replacement biological validation panel.
Saved templates are matched to actual treated batch proportions, information unavailable for challenge targets.
Historical confirmation data were already inspected. No tuning, reselection or submission modification occurs.
DE metrics are not recomputed: saved profiles cannot reconstruct per-cell rank tests.

original_training_extraction.selection: First source-ordered 32 controls per batch; first N target cells per target/batch, adaptive bounded plan

additional_splits.selection: Existing 1536 training controls matched by ID and exactly verified, first N target cells per target/batch; largest predeclared N fitting bounded range plan.
Existing 1536 training controls matched by ID and exactly verified, first N target cells per target/batch; largest predeclared N fitting bounded range plan.

source.scope: Released public 2025 H1, combined unique cells; source batch splits globally disjoint; no hidden 2026 response data.

selection_record.selection: Random within batch; round-robin across batches; cap/2 cells per target per disjoint batch partition; controls maximum 32 per batch.
selection_record.offset_repair: Exclude cells absent from expression fragments; subtract complete missing-cell expression record counts from later global offsets; verify 128 retained cell starts across full axis.

source.canonical_gene_mapping: Original gene token IDs mapped to original symbols; duplicate source symbols summed on challenge axis, never dropped because of converted suffixes.
source.normalization: Full-source library verified before gene-axis projection; missing genes remain masked.
source.scope: Stratified target and control sample across full release batches, not every raw cell.
